name: plugin.secret_scanner
description: Pre-ingestion and on-demand credential & API key scanner with Shannon entropy analysis

entrypoints.name: scan_text
entrypoints.description: Scan raw text or code string for potential credentials, tokens, and private keys

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content to analyze for secrets

entrypoints.name: scan_file
entrypoints.description: Scan a specific file on disk for leaked credentials and keys

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the file to scan

entrypoints.name: scan_directory
entrypoints.description: Recursively scan a directory tree for leaked credentials and secret tokens
